name: BetterFolders
description: Shows server folders on dedicated sidebar and adds folder related improvements
summary: Open server folders on a second rail, and rules for when folders open and close

settings.label: Sidebar
settings.description: Display servers from folder on dedicated sidebar

settings.label: Close all folders
settings.description: Close all folders when selecting a server not in a folder

settings.label: Close all folders on home
settings.description: Close all folders when clicking on the home button

settings.label: Close other folders
settings.description: Close other folders when opening a folder

settings.label: Close server folder
settings.description: Close folder when selecting a server in that folder

settings.label: Force open
settings.description: Force a folder to open when switching to a server of that folder

settings.label: Keep icons
settings.description: Keep showing guild icons in the primary guild bar folder when it's open in the BetterFolders sidebar

settings.label: Show folder icon
settings.description: Show the folder icon above the folder guilds in the BetterFolders sidebar

choices.label: When more than one folder is expanded

notes: With the sidebar on, opening a server folder shows its servers on a second rail beside the server list (under the folder's icon, by the setting), and the server list shows just the open folder unless "Keep icons" is on; the rail goes away when every folder is closed. The other settings close folders when you select a server outside them or in them, click the home button, or open another folder, and open a folder when you switch to one of its servers. It works with Qord's classic channel list (server list plus channels).
gaps: The sidebar appears without upstream's opening animation ("Sidebar animation" does nothing yet).
